author: MiniWarGaming
description:
From the very start of Warhammer 40K, the Dark Kin have stalked through the shadows and been an ever-present threat to anyone caught unaware.

Join Skari and Josh as they look through the history of the Dark Eldar, starting from the Dark Elf Space Trooper and going all the way to the Lady Malys.

What's your favourite edition of Drukhari lore? Let us know in the comments! 

In collaboration with Skari from Skaredcast - http://patreon.com/skaredcast
